description: CCS Open Data Stormwater Drains is the City of Charles Sturt's maintained spatial layer of stormwater drainage assets in South Australia. It represents about 430 km of pipes that transfer runoff to receiving waters or storage areas. The ArcGIS feature layer stores line geometry and attributes including asset number, construction year, drain type, catchment, dimensions, grade, inlet and outlet invert, length and material. The Council says the network was first captured in 2002 and is continually maintained by its Asset Planning Management team. The public FeatureServer exposes queryable JSON, GeoJSON and PBF formats, as well as SQLite and file-geodatabase exports; the layer metadata uses EPSG:3857. The endpoint is publicly accessible without registration. The service identifies the City as copyright holder, but its layer metadata does not state a reuse licence or price. Confirm reuse terms with the Council before redistribution or commercial use. Coverage is the City of Charles Sturt. The asset geometry and pipe attributes can support drainage-network representation, hydraulic model setup, flow planning and flood-exposure studies. No directly linked catalogue record was confirmed.
